briefTitle: Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy Planning With Artificial Intelligence-Directed Dose Recommendation for Treatment of Primary or Metastatic Lung Tumors, RAD-AI Study

typedChecks.sourceText: Patients must exhibit an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0-2.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Patients must exhibit an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0-2.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Stage I Lung Cancer AJCC v8, Stage II Lung Cancer AJCC v8, Stage IIIA Lung Cancer AJCC v8
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: This trial includes stage I and II in addition to stage IIIA lung cancer, but involves radiation therapy planning for various lung tumors where stage alone is not a straightforward stage_in inclusion list across all enrolled participants.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have radiographically measurable or evaluable disease per RECIST v. 1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable or evaluable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients of child-bearing potential (POCBP) must have a negative urine or serum pregnancy test prior to registration on study.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pregnancy test requirement is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients of child-bearing potential (POCBP) must agree to use adequate contraception...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Contraception agreement is a behavioral requirement, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have the ability to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Informed consent willingness is a subjective judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients who have had prior radiotherapy with radiation field overlap.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior radiotherapy overlap is an anatomical and treatment history judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: For primary lung cancers, patients with ground glass opacities without a solid component will be excluded.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Ground glass opacity morphology evaluation is an imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients who have not recovered from adverse events confined to the thorax (i.e. pneumonitis, bronchial insufficiency, bronchial hemorrhage, esophagitis) due to prior anticancer therapy (i.e., have residual toxicities >= grade 2)...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Unresolved prior toxicity grade evaluation is a clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients who are receiving any other concurrent investigational agents or genotoxic chemotherapy for cancer treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concurrent investigational agent exclusion is a treatment history rule with complex exceptions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with a prior or concurrent malignancy whose natural history or treatment has the potential to interfere with the safety or efficacy assessment... Patients who have an uncontrolled intercurrent illness including... any other illness or condition that the treating investigator feels would interfere with study compliance...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator discretion and complex uncontrolled illness definitions are subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Female patients who are pregnant or nursing.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pregnancy/nursing exclusion is not a typed lab or condition check.
